note.question: How does competition at the e-commerce platform shape a strategic perspective?
note.overview: This paper examines the economic effects of the fulfillment services offered by Amazon (FBA) to the third-party sellers on its retail platform. It is intriguing that the third-party sellers that use FBA may directly compete with Amazon.
